stem.en: ABC Bakery packs its pastries in sealed boxes with the bakery's name on them, not in loose paper. Which two things does this help with?

text.en: The pastries look better and stay fresh for longer.
The bakery needs fewer bakers and fewer helpers.
The pastries cost less to make and less to sell.
Customers cannot compare its prices with other shops.

explanation.en: The book asks what kind of packaging can make bakery goods more attractive and give them a longer shelf-life. A sealed box with the bakery's name does both.

hints.en: Think about how a box looks, and what it does to the pastry inside.
